text: Sorry to message so late. I'm fostering a little boy, he's 3, only been with us a few weeks so I don't know what's normal for him yet and I'm scared I'll miss something. He's come up in a blotchy pinkish rash on his tummy and back tonight. I did the glass thing I read about and it goes pale when I press it, all of it, I checked three times. His breathing's completely normal, I've been sat watching him and it's nice and steady. There's also a big bruise on his shin but that's from Saturday, he went flying off the bottom of the slide at the park and I was right there, it's just going yellow now. I keep thinking I'll get it wrong with him because he's not mine. Can someone tell me what I should be keeping an eye on
